message.content:
Re-run + fix the pricing-parity test you wrote at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts.

Prior run: 12 passed, 3 failed. Failures were test-authoring bugs (NOT product bugs):

1. Quarterly/Annually tab click — `getByRole("button", { name: /quarterly/i })` is ambiguous because both PricingSection AND RoiCalculator render a button with that label. Strict mode rejects.
   FIX: scope to PricingSection's tab group. The pricing toggle has `role="group" aria-label="Billing period"` (see /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/home/pricing-section.tsx lines 78-82). Use:
   `page.getByRole('group', { name: 'Billing period' }).getByRole('button', { name: /quarterly/i })`
   Same for Annually click + any subsequent toggle interactions.

2. ROI calculator section — JUST PATCHED in product:
   - Section now has `id="roi-calc"` and `aria-labelledby="roi-calc-heading"`
   - Heading has `id="roi-calc-heading"` text "See Your Real Savings Before You Commit"
   FIX: assert with `page.locator('#roi-calc')` visible AND `page.locator('#roi-calc-heading')` text.

Tasks:
1. Edit tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts to apply the two selector fixes
2. Re-run `pnpm test:e2e tests/pricing-parity.spec.ts`
3. Report final pass/fail count + any new failures with diagnosis
4. If anything still fails for product reasons (not test reasons), name the file:line that needs product fix
5. Background the dev server if not already running, kill at end

Under 200 words.
